# Dušan Stanić

> Dušan Stanić is a Platform Engineer at HYPR with experience in release systems and multi-cloud infrastructure.

Dušan built Blaze on the Nutanix Frame team. At Dizzion / Frame, every engineering team used the Go tool to run deployment checks and manage releases for 12 services across AWS, Azure, and Nutanix AHV. At Dizzion / Frame, Dušan also migrated five production services from CentOS 7 to Ubuntu without downtime.

Location: Belgrade, Serbia.
